_about: Practice questions for box v19 and the model parser's prompt version 4, written by the coder on 24 October 2026 for the second claim run's design B. Development only, in sample, never held out: prompt v4 and decision 11 were developed on these and on paraphrases_v1.json alone.

The schema is paraphrases_v1.json's: id, template (a design B template id), label (clear or ambiguous, null where not judged), audit_expected (what the box under the model parser should do, in the audit's words: a plan's kind, ASK or REFUSE), text and meaning_kept.

The texts leave the market to whoever reads them: {brand}, and for the promo checks {seller} and {promo}, and for the limit {limit}, as tests/test_design_b.py fills them on a made-up page; templates, base_url, lead and page_from are null for the same reason.

Covered: tee-xs-price (with label traps in the wording), tee-promo-check, decline-fit, decline-scarcity, decline-delivery, the word list against the model on availability (ids 11 to 14, decision 11), the offer ambiguity, and one each of the bound, existence and top-3 questions. No answer keys: no agent runs on these.
